Hi 

My name is Mohsin Rehman. I work as a Du Sales Officer, specializing in supporting holiday homes companies.

I currently work with several well-known holiday home operators, including:

· First Class Vacation Homes
· Settlers Home
· Shell Grow
· Colife
· Magistic Holiday Home
· PVH Holidays Home
· Lux Royal
· Lux Air
· Aura Holidays Home
· Busybee Vacation Home

For these clients, I handle:

· New Du connections
· Troubleshooting
· Providing new routers
· Supplying used Du routers (if needed)
· Sales and after-sales service

I truly admire fam living as  a leading company in this space. I have been trying to reach you for a long time but couldn’t find your direct number.

I would really appreciate a chance to prove myself and my work. I’m confident I can support fam living with reliable, fast telecom service for your properties.

Thank you for your time. Looking forward to the opportunity.

Best regards,
Mohsin Rehman
Du Sales Officer
